metadata.name: ManageBankAccounts
metadata.description: This API is to add/update/delete the bank account details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: BankAccountType
request_fields.description: Type of Bank account added by customer for card payment,0=checking and 1=saving Valid Values:0,1 Format:X Example:0,1

request_fields.name: BankAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Bank Account Number Valid Values:00000001234567891 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:00000001234567891 Condition:Mandatory when Request Type is 0 i.e Add. Allowable Values: 17

request_fields.name: BankRoutingNumber
request_fields.description: Bank Rrouting number identifies the location of the bank's branch Valid Values:111000038 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example: 111000038 Condition:Mandatory when Request Type is 0 i.e Add. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: BankName
request_fields.description: Name of the Bank Valid Values: A-Z Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:ABC Corporation Condition:Mandatory when Request Type is 0 i.e Add. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: CreditBalanceRefund
request_fields.description: Flag to tag the bank account for credit balance refund ,Only and Only one Bank Account can be 1 (Yes)  of an Account. Valid Values:0-No, 1-Yes. Example: 1

request_fields.name: RequestType
request_fields.description: Request Type defines the action to be perform in Bank Account. Possible value would be (0 : Add, 1 : Delete, 2 : Update) Valid Values:0  Add 1  Delete 2  Update Format:X

request_fields.name: MethodName
request_fields.description: Method Name uniquely identifies bank accounts in Core card system. Whenever user adds any bank account. Required if request type = 1 or 2 (Update or delete request.) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:4092

request_fields.name: ApplicantType
request_fields.description: Selects the type of Applicants. Valid Values: 1,2,3 Example: 1='Applicant', 2 ='Co-Applicant', 3='Cosigner'

request_fields.name: UniqueId
request_fields.description: Unique ID is a transaction specific unique ID. This ID is unique for every transaction. If multiple calls are made by client for a specific transaction, the value of this tag will always be the same for a specific transaction. (GUID and UUID datatypes are supported for this tag). Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: F965C56F-C58F-EC11-B80E-A4BF010A357E Condition:For API user, if API Idempotency Applicable is set as Yes on CoreCredit, field is mandatory. The UniqueId is valid for 7 days from first submission of the request. Same request can be retried for 7 days without performing the same action twice.Idempotency will be checked at the belongingOwning Partner and Merchant Level. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: OverrideBankVerificationMethod
request_fields.description: Value in this tag will override the default Program set up of bank verification method. If blank, then default Program level set up will be honoured. Valid Values: 0=None, 1=PreNote, 2=MicroDeposit, 3=ThirdPartyValidation Example: 0

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking

children.name: MethodName
children.description: Method Name uniquely identifies bank accounts in Core card system. Whenever user adds any bank account. Required if request type = 1 or 2 (Update or delete request.) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:4092
